text.zh: 确认市场、人群、指标定义与样本条件，界定横向和跨期比较的范围。
text.en: Check markets, audiences, measure definitions, and sample criteria before defining cross-market and cross-wave comparisons.

text.zh: 对照相对权重与相关分析的排序，判断差异是否来自方法或样本变化。
text.en: Compare rankings from relative weight and correlation analyses, and assess whether differences reflect the method or sample.

text.zh: 把统计结果放回研究问题，解释与满意度关联的体验因素及后续研究方向。
text.en: Relate the statistical findings to the research question, explaining experience factors associated with satisfaction and directions for further research.

title.zh: 把分析方法写成可复跑的流程。

text.zh: 借助 Codex 按确定的方法完成分市场相对权重、相关分析与跨期对照。
text.en: Use Codex to apply the chosen methods across markets, producing relative weights, correlations, and wave comparisons.

text.zh: 通过独立复算和方法对照检查异常排名，再判断是否需要调整或补充解释。
text.en: Check unexpected rankings with independent recalculation and method comparisons before deciding on corrections or further interpretation.

text.zh: 将分析规则和检查步骤保留在脚本中，后续沿用同一处理流程。
text.en: Keep the analysis rules and validation steps in scripts that can be rerun for subsequent work.

title.zh: 交付报告，也留下下一次能复用的方法。
title.en: Deliver insight and a reusable method.

text.zh: 形成跨市场分析报告与研究建议，说明满意度关联因素及市场差异。
text.en: Deliver a cross-market report and research recommendations, explaining satisfaction-related factors and market differences.

text.zh: 形成跨期对照与方法 SOP，让比较条件、计算方法和复核步骤能够沿用。
text.en: Produce wave comparisons and an analysis guide so criteria, calculations, and checks can be reused.

text.zh: 减少逐次重建计算流程，把精力更多用于解释差异、检查结论与提出建议。
text.en: Reduce repeated analytical setup, allowing more attention to interpreting differences, checking conclusions, and developing recommendations.

title.zh: 先厘清跨期比较与更新边界。
title.en: Set the comparison and update boundaries.

text.zh: 梳理客群、品类、指标与历史定义，确认哪些差异可以直接比较。
text.en: Review audiences, categories, measures, and historical definitions to establish valid comparisons.

text.zh: 明确数据、监测平台、图表和对应文字的关系，确定本次更新范围。
text.en: Map the relationships between data, the tracking platform, charts, and text, then define the update scope.

text.zh: 判断差异应该修正、保留还是补充说明，避免把有效历史结果一并覆盖。
text.en: Decide whether a difference requires correction, preservation, or explanation, while retaining valid historical results.

title.zh: 让多期文件按同一套规则同步。
title.en: Align recurring work through shared rules.

text.zh: 将研究规则写入程序，批量比对多期文件，把差异定位到对应内容。
text.en: Encode research rules and compare files across waves, tracing differences to the relevant content.

text.zh: 按既定模板更新表格、图表和对应文字，保持数据与报告的一致关系。
text.en: Update tables, charts, and related text within existing templates, preserving the relationship between data and reports.

text.zh: 保留来源与核验记录，将批量处理和需要研究者判断的问题分开。
text.en: Keep source and validation records, distinguishing batch operations from issues requiring researcher judgment.

title.zh: 交付保持一致的数据、图表与判断。
title.en: Deliver aligned data, charts, and interpretation.

text.zh: 完成多期数据与报告更新，支持品牌认知、评价和形象的持续追踪。
text.en: Complete multi-wave data and report updates to support continued tracking of brand awareness, perceptions, and image.

text.zh: 形成后续项目可复用的处理程序与检查方法，保留有效历史结果。
text.en: Create reusable processing tools and validation methods while preserving valid historical results.

text.zh: 把逐份查找和重复复制改为批量处理与重点复核，减少重复操作。
text.en: Replace file-by-file searching and repeated copying with batch processing and targeted review.

title.zh: 从研究问题，设计查询的结构。
title.en: Shape the query around the research question.

text.zh: 确认产品资料与比较标准，明确研究需要回答的问题。
text.en: Define the product sources and comparison criteria around the research question.

text.zh: 梳理产品分类与指标定义，让后续查询沿用一致的含义。
text.en: Organize product categories and measure definitions for consistent queries.

text.zh: 把来源记录纳入数据结构，让资料能够回溯。
text.en: Include source records in the data structure so information can be traced.

title.zh: 把研究要求，落成可操作的原型。
title.en: Turn research requirements into a working prototype.

text.zh: 借助 Codex 实现 SQLite 数据结构，整理分散的产品资料。
text.en: Use Codex to implement a SQLite structure for scattered product information.

text.zh: 实现多维筛选、图表与明细联动，支持产品查询与比较。
text.en: Implement filters and linked charts and detail views to support product queries and comparisons.

text.zh: 将查询与比较结果导出，衔接后续分析。
text.en: Export query and comparison results for further analysis.

title.zh: 让分散的资料，成为可查询的产品。
title.en: Make scattered sources useful as a research product.

text.zh: 已实现产品查询与比较，减少在不同资料间反复查找。
text.en: The prototype supports queries and comparisons without repeatedly searching separate sources.

text.zh: 完成数据来源、采购需求与产品可行性的初步评估。
text.en: Initial assessments of data sources, procurement needs, and feasibility are complete.

text.zh: 将研究问题、数据结构与交互实现连成可操作的流程。
text.en: Connect research questions, data structures, and interaction in an operational workflow.
